mapper.select: select d.id , d.inventory_id , d.goods_id , d.save_num , d.stock_num , d.create_time , g.goods_name , g.units , i.order_no , i.expire_time from member_inventory_detail d left join member_inventory_goods g ON d.goods_id = g.id left join member_inventory_info i ON i.id = d.inventory_id where d.deleted = 0 and i.deleted = 0 and d.stock_num > 0 and i.store_id = #{storeId} and i.user_id = #{userId} order by i.expire_time asc

select d.id , i.store_id , s.store_name , d.inventory_id , d.goods_id , g.goods_name , g.units , d.save_num , d.stock_num , d.create_time , i.expire_time from member_inventory_detail d left join member_inventory_goods g ON d.goods_id = g.id left join member_inventory_info i ON i.id = d.inventory_id left join member_store_info s ON i.store_id = s.store_id where d.deleted = 0 and i.deleted = 0 and i.user_id = #{userId} and d.stock_num>0
AND locate(#{storeName},s.store_name)>0
and i.expire_time >= now()
and i.expire_time < now()
order by i.expire_time asc
